sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Sales of Musical Instruments and Studio Audio Gear

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement (in force since 2012)
Colombia-European Union Trade Agreement (provisionally applied since 2013)
Colombia-Canada Free Trade Agreement (in force since 2011)
Colombia-Spain Double Taxation and Investment Protection Agreement
Pacific Alliance Framework Agreement (Colombia, Chile, Mexico, Peru)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 526 de 1999 (UIAF anti-money-laundering framework), as amended by Ley 1121 de 2006; Decreto Unico Reglamentario 1067 de 2015, Book 3; Ley 2195 de 2022 (mandatory Declaracion de Beneficiario Final); Superintendencia de Sociedades and UIAF resolutions on SARLAFT and the Registro Unico de Beneficiarios Finales. The 'beneficiario final' is an individual who directly or indirectly holds or controls more than 10% of share capital or voting rights.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder (Certificado de Existencia y Representacion)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company register in the shareholder's country of origin (e.g., Companies House, Delaware Secretary of State, or equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille by the issuing state; if the originating state is not a party to the Apostille Convention, Consular Legalization by the Colombian Embassy or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney executed by each foreign UBO, shareholder, director or legal representative authorizing the Colombian incorporator to sign and file the S.A.S. articles of association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or, where applicable, Consular Legalization before the competent Colombian consular officer

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport of each individual UBO, shareholder and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public, competent national authority or consular office in the country of issuance

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or apostilled bank reference letter / AML clearance certificate from the corporate shareholder's principal bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Bank of the corporate shareholder or UBO

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of each UBO, shareholder, legal representative and authorized signatory against (i) the consolidated UN Security Council sanctions list, (ii) OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and non-SDN lists, (iii) the EU consolidated financial sanctions list, and (iv) Colombian national PEP and money-laundering registries administered by UIAF and the Superintendencia de Sociedades. All screening results must be documented in the pre-incorporation file. Any positive hit triggers enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth documentation and, for PEPs, senior management approval before proceeding.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (RUES) through the relevant Camara de Comercio (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be written in Spanish or in Latin-script transliteration; the mandatory suffix is 'S.A.S.' or 'Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada' may be written out. Foreign words are generally accepted only where transliterated into Spanish script or supported by a registered trademark or common usage. The name must be clearly distinguishable from all existing and reserved names in the RUES national database.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If the requested name is rejected, the incorporation agent may file a 'recurso de reposicion' before the same Camara de Comercio within ten working days, and a subsidiary 'recurso de apelacion' before the Superintendencia de Sociedades within ten working days. The appeal must attach the initial RUES search certificate and demonstrate that no identical or substantially similar name is active or reserved. If the rejection is based on a prohibited or sensitive token, the applicant must either amend the name or obtain prior written authorization from the relevant ministry or supervisory authority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is permissible for an online musical-instrument and audio-gear retailer only if the provider supplies a physical Colombian street address, is contractually engaged to receive judicial and administrative notices, and maintains a physical place of business during normal working hours. A post-office box alone is invalid. The Camara de Comercio and DIAN will verify that the registered address is not fictitious and that commercial substance is demonstrable.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate, approximately 12% within the first 12 months, based on routine Camara de Comercio conformity checks and DIAN unannounced verification visits; no sector-specific licensing or security trigger applies to online audio equipment retail.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff of the Camara de Comercio (approx. 0.5 UVT)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and consular authentication of powers of attorney, corporate existence certificates and passport copies (per foreign incorporator)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Hague Apostille regulatory fee and Colombian consular legalization tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Spanish translation of apostilled foreign documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark per translated page

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization of the S.A.S. incorporation document and declaration of UBO
Commercial registration with Camara de Comercio, RUES enrollment and issuance of Certificado de Existencia y Representacion Legal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Camara de Comercio del domicilio social
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official registration tariff for companies with no substantial capital contributions (approx. 1.1 UVT)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIT (tax ID) application before DIAN and electronic signature activation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Direccion de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: DIAN statutory registration fee waiver; professional fee of designated counsel or accountant

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP, OFAC, UN sanctions and UBO enhanced due diligence screening (per UBO)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance data provider and legal counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for per-UBO enhanced due diligence in Latin America

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Virtual registered office and legal correspondence service, first 12 months
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing serviced-office market rate in Bogota or Medellin central business district

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Counsel fees for drafting S.A.S. bylaws, minutes, UBO register and full incorporation support
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Law firm or registered corporate service provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark flat fee for low-risk S.A.S. incorporation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law 1258 of 2008, Articles 2, 5, 7, 14 and 22; Commercial Code (Código de Comercio), Articles 110 and 353; Decree 019 of 2012 on anti-trámites and single-window registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [City] – Registro Mercantil, supervised by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución y Estatutos (Private Incorporation Document and Bylaws)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital applies to a S.A.S. The authorized, subscribed, and paid-in capital are freely determined in the bylaws. The subscribed capital may be paid in deferred installments within two years under Article 5 of Law 1258 of 2008. No escrow account is legally required for a standard cash-funded S.A.S.; however, in-kind contributions must be valued and evidenced in the incorporation document.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: WHEREAS the sole shareholder of the Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada ("S.A.S.") resolves to formalize corporate existence under Law 1258 of 2008. IT IS RESOLVED: 1. That the subscription and issuance of one hundred percent (100%) of the authorized shares is accepted and the subscribed capital is payable in cash in accordance with the deferred contribution rule. 2. That the registered office is fixed at the address stated in the bylaws, in the municipality of incorporation. 3. That [Full Name] is appointed Legal Representative, [Full Name] as Alternate Legal Representative, and [Full Name] as Corporate Secretary. 4. That the Legal Representative is authorized to execute all incorporation, tax-registration, banking, and license filings necessary to commence operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Availability Search and Reservation with the Chamber of Commerce
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [City] / Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES portal and request the certificate of name availability (consulta de nombre) for the proposed S.A.S. denomination. If available, complete the online request to reserve the name for the Chamber's specified term. File the request at the Chamber with jurisdiction over the intended registered office.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name
Tax identification number or passport of each shareholder
Identity document of the applying shareholder or authorized agent
Email address and telephone contact
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to similarity, file a new availability request with a distinctive alternative denomination or file a written reconsideration before the same Chamber attaching the refusal notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of Private Incorporation Document and Bylaws
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public (Notaría) in the registered-office city and/or Cámara de Comercio electronic authentication service
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución and the bylaws in accordance with Law 1258 of 2008. Have the signatures of all founders authenticated at the notary or through the Chamber’s authorized electronic channel. The document must set the company name, registered office, corporate purpose, capital structure, representation powers, and officer appointments.
required_dossiers: Draft private incorporation document and complete bylaws
Founder identity documents (cédula or passport)
Name availability certificate
Evidence of subscribed capital payment if immediate payment is elected
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or Chamber notes a deficiency, correct the draft and resubmit within the validity period; no incorporation fee is forfeited when the corrected document is refiled timely.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-RUT and Provisional Tax Identification Number Application
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) through the Cámara de Comercio single window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Formulario Pre-RUT at the Chamber’s single window together with the incorporation document. The Chamber transmits the form to DIAN, which assigns a provisional NIT. This provisional number permits completion of the commercial registry and bank account opening.
required_dossiers: Formulario Pre-RUT
Executed incorporation document of the S.A.S.
Founder and legal representative identity documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects the Pre-RUT due to data inconsistency, reconcile the shareholder and representative personal data and resubmit through the Chamber; no new notarization is ordinarily required.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de [City] – Registro Mercantil
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the incorporation document, Pre-RUT confirmation, completed formulario de inscripción, and proof of payment of the registration tariff. The Chamber registers the company and issues the Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation and the Commercial Register entry (Registro Mercantil).
required_dossiers: Original private incorporation document and bylaws
Formulario de Registro y Matrícula Mercantil
Pre-RUT / provisional NIT certificate
Receipt of chamber registration fee
Identity document of the legal representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry official identifies a missing bylaw provision, execute a complementary accessory document (documento privado complementario) and refile; prompt cure does not require a new incorporation document.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Definitive RUT and Tax Registration with DIAN
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After commercial registration, update the RUT through DIAN’s electronic portal using the provisional NIT and the Chamber-issued certificate. Select the applicable income tax and VAT responsibilities and the relevant ISIC activity codes, including ISIC 4791 online retail of musical instruments and audio equipment.
required_dossiers: Provisional NIT certificate
Certificate of Existence and Legal Representation issued by the Chamber
Legal representative identity document
Company email and registered address data
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN withholds finalization pending documentary review, verify the certified email, present the Chamber certificate at the local DIAN office, and provide a corrected RUT form.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Land-Use Clearance and Fire Safety / Occupational Compliance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Secretaría de Planeación / Curaduría Urbana, Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos, and Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain a certificate of land use (uso de suelo) for the registered warehouse or office; secure a fire-prevention inspection for the premises where the local threshold applies; register employees with an occupational-hazard insurer (ARL); and implement the mandatory occupational health and safety system (SG-SST).
required_dossiers: Copy of the commercial registration certificate
Lease or title proof of the premises
Building floor plan and occupancy data
Completed fire-safety inspection request form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the local authority issues a clearance deficiency, submit the remedial construction or occupancy plan before the Curaduría Urbana or municipal planning secretary; emergency measures may include a temporary occupancy permit while remediation is pending.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for pure ISIC 4791 online retail; municipal Secretaría de Planeación and Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos condition physical operation. If goods are imported, DIAN customs registration and an authorized customs broker are required.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No industrial operating license is required; the company must obtain Certificado de Uso de Suelo and, for premises-based storage, the Bomberos fire-safety concept.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Autoridad Nacional de Licencias Ambientales (ANLA) / Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) as applicable
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – no EIA required under Decreto 1076 of 2015 for online retail and dry-storage warehousing.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No VOC or process-emission thresholds apply to pure warehousing and office activities. If any wastewater effluent is generated, compliance with Resolución 631 de 2015 discharge limits is required. Returned or battery-containing electronic audio products must be managed as hazardous waste under Decreto 4741 de 2005 and Resolution 1407 de 2018 packaging and battery take-back rules.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The warehouse/office must obtain a Concepto de Protección contra Incendios from the Cuerpo Oficial de Bomberos, demonstrate structural load compliance to the local Curaduría Urbana, enroll workers with an ARL, and implement the SG-SST system under Resolution 0312 de 2019, including evacuation drills and workplace risk assessments.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN); electronic portal: DIAN website (www.dian.gov.co) and the MUISCA transactional web platform, including the Unified Tax Registry (RUT) module.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Colombian S.A.S. must obtain a NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) as the single statutory TIN/VAT ID before commencing business. Procedure: (i) incorporate the S.A.S. by private deed and register the company with the local Cámara de Comercio (commercial registry); (ii) appoint a legal representative resident in Colombia or a lawful attorney-in-fact (apoderado) authorized to act before DIAN; (iii) complete registration in the RUT through the DIAN virtual office, declaring the company’s address, ISIC-4791 economic activity, and responsible VAT status; (iv) activate the electronic invoicing digital certificate (firma electrónica) issued by a DIAN-authorized certification provider; and (v) for non-resident digital sellers without a fixed establishment, use the non-resident registration mechanism for VAT identification where DIAN assigns a special foreign-seller NIT.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation — The S.A.S. is a Colombian juridical person taxed at entity level under the general corporate income tax regime; it has no look-through or pass-through treatment; profits are taxable at the corporate rate and distributions to shareholders are separately subject to dividend withholding tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box election. The S.A.S. may elect: (i) the ordinary corporate income tax regime or, where eligible, the Simplified Taxation Regime (Régimen Simple de Tributación – SIMPLE), which consolidates income tax, municipal industry and commerce tax, and VAT in a single instalment; (ii) status as an IVA 'responsable' under the general regime; (iii) application for Free Trade Zone (Zona Franca) treatment conferring a reduced income tax rate provided the relevant registration and investment commitments are met; and (iv) for hybrid mismatch situations, compliance is mandatory under Law 1819/2016 — no elective protective classification exists.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Impuesto al Valor Agregado (IVA) — Value Added Tax; retail sales of tangible goods in Colombia are also within the local municipal Industry and Commerce Tax (ICA) jurisdiction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: COP 0 — No general monetary registration threshold applies. The S.A.S. engaged in the retail sale of musical instruments and studio audio equipment must register with DIAN as a VAT 'responsable' before the first sale in the national territory. For reference, the optional SIMPLE regime has an eligibility ceiling of approximately 80,000 UVT; the standard 19% IVA regime applies to all corporate sellers above or below that threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory nationwide electronic invoicing (Factura Electrónica de Venta – FEV) applies to every VAT-responsible S.A.S. Invoices must be generated through DIAN-approved software or the authorized technological platform, formatted in UBL 2.1 XML, signed with the DIAN-validated digital certificate, and transmitted to DIAN in the applicable validation mode ('Validación Previa' or 'Validación Posterior') with accepted/rejected status event processing. Each valid invoice must display a two-dimensional digital stamp containing the CUFE (Código Único de Facturación Electrónica) and DIAN web verification code. The S.A.S. must also interoperate with RADIAN for electronic invoice financing where applicable. Online payment gateways such as Stripe and PayPal do not replace or discharge the Colombian seller’s fiscal e-invoicing duty.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Sales of musical instruments and studio audio gear by a Colombian S.A.S. to foreign buyers qualify for the 0% IVA export rate where the goods physically depart Colombia through customs control and are evidenced by an accepted export declaration. The 0% rate applies to definitive exports of tangible goods, including shipments via international courier under simplified export procedures, and to services rendered from Colombia to foreign jurisdictions where the service is exclusively used abroad and territoriality requirements are met. The supplier must be an IVA-responsible person, maintain the relevant export contracts, and retain documentary proof of dispatch, destination, and foreign receipt.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación – DEX) accepted by DIAN/MUISCA with authorization of definitive exit
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or courier consignment note (Master/HAWB) evidencing physical departure from Colombia
Commercial invoice consistent with the DEX and the foreign buyer
Inward remittance certificate (certificado de reintegro de divisas) issued by the local commercial bank or the foreign-exchange declaration (declaración de cambio)
For zero-rated services, the Certificate of Foreign Use or Certificado de Ausencia de Causación (CAC) supporting exclusive foreign consumption
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN strictly audits zero-rated export claims and refund applications. The 0% rate and any input VAT refund are lost if export proceeds are not repatriated to Colombia within 180 days of the export declaration, or within the additional period expressly authorized by the foreign-exchange regulations; failure triggers retroactive collection of 19% IVA on the export value plus default interest from the date of dispatch. Inaccuracies or fraudulent refunds expose the S.A.S. to the statutory inexactitude penalty of up to 200% of the tax determined, a specific sanction of 100% of improperly obtained refunds, suspension from RUT and electronic invoicing, and criminal liability for fiscal fraud under Law 1943/2018, including imprisonment for culpable personnel.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered city (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually between 1 January and 31 March; renewal must reflect the immediately preceding fiscal year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-renewal penalty calculated on the tariff plus daily interest; continued failure for more than one annual period causes registration dormancy and eventual administrative strike-off from the register.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Shareholder-approved Annual Financial Statements (Estados Financieros) and, if applicable, auditor's report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio as part of the annual commercial renewal; additionally Superintendencia de Sociedades when the entity is subject to its supervision
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year ends 31 December; financial statements must be approved by the shareholders within three months after year-end, i.e., by 31 March of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Legal representative may be fined by the Superintendencia; failure to file precludes timely commercial renewal and issuance of compliance certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income and Complementary Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementario — Form 110)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filing deadline published annually by DIAN based on the last two digits of NIT; for calendar-year entities the window falls between February and May of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty under Article 641 ET plus default interest; persistent non-filing creates enforced collection actions and arrears recorded in the tax certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Owner Registry Update (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales - RUBF)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual confirmation due within the same tax-filing deadline as the income tax return; any qualifying shareholding transfer or control change must be reported within ten business days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines of up to 200 monthly minimum wages for late or false reporting; separate infringement treated independently of income tax delinquency.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A S.A.S. is required to appoint a Revisor Fiscal if total assets or gross income exceed 5,000 current monthly minimum wages (SMLMV), or if it has 50 or more employees; appointment is also mandatory if the by-laws require it or the Superintendencia de Sociedades imposes it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian accounting framework under Law 1314/2009 and Decreto Único Reglamentario 2420/2015: full IFRS for Grupo 1, IFRS for SMEs for Grupo 2, and simplified accounting standards for Grupo 3.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All S.A.S. shareholders, including beneficial owners acting through intermediaries, must be identified; annual RUBF confirmation must be submitted through DIAN regardless of whether ownership changed, and every transfer of shares or change of control triggers an update within ten business days.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas), including board meeting minutes if applicable
Shareholders' Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea o Junta de Socios)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - USD 5,000 per year, depending on asset size, transactions, and auditor selection

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday applies to online sales of musical instruments and studio audio gear. The SAS may only reduce effective corporate tax through ordinary deductions: cost of sales, local payroll, e-commerce platform fees, logistics, depreciation of equipment, and qualifying R&D expenditure. No preferential regime exists for ISIC 4791 retail activity in Colombia.
